CHECK BURST K4v-chk-01 — slice the frost-bolt sheets into module frames, measure them with the frozen VFX gates, and composite the CAST module at the staff-tip socket on the S cast cell (Run C-3 P5, fork B). REPORT ONLY. task_id "K4v-chk-01".

Inputs (read-only): sheets /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/K4v-gen-cast-a/cast_00_03.png, /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/K4v-gen-cast-b/cast_04_07.png (2×2, row-major), /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/K4v-gen-travel-a/travel_00_03.png (2×2), /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/K4v-gen-travel-b/travel_04_05.png (2 columns × 1 row), /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/K4v-gen-impact-a/impact_00_03.png (2×2), /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/K4v-gen-impact-b/impact_04_07.png (2×2), /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/K4v-gen-impact-c/impact_08_09.png (2×1) — black #000000 emission plates. Character: the S cast cut /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/P4c-S-cast/cut/frames/cast/S/cast_S_00..07.png (8 frames @ 20 fps, 512 RGBA) and /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/P4c-S-cast/cut/registration.json (transform). Frozen tools under /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/ (run, never modify): gates/vfx_lifecycle.py (evaluate(module, frames, fps)), gates/element_hue.py (evaluate(frames,'frost')), gates/attachment.py, oracles/pse_check.py, review/composite_socket.py (estimate_sockets, composite), review/encode.py. python glue importing these is fine; no new tool files.

STEP 1 — slice: split each sheet into equal cells exactly as its grid says (measure the real image size; cells = width/cols × height/rows). Emission → RGBA per cell: alpha = max(R,G,B); RGB = RGB·255/alpha where alpha > 0 (clip 0..255); alpha = 0 where max(R,G,B) < 8. Sizes: cast cells → 256×256 (LANCZOS); travel cells → take the centred horizontal band of height = cell_height/2 and resize to 256×128; impact cells → 384×384. Frame order cast 0..7, travel 0..5, impact 0..9. Write out/vfx/frames/{cast,travel,impact}/<module>_NN.png.
STEP 2 — measure (every passed as returned by the frozen gate, but add a top-level note that these are reports): vfx_lifecycle.evaluate('cast', cast, 20), ('travel', travel, 12), ('impact', impact, 20); element_hue.evaluate(frames,'frost') per module; pse per module sequence at its fps → out/checks.json {modules:{cast:[...],travel:[...],impact:[...]}}.
STEP 3 — composite: sockets = composite_socket.estimate_sockets(character frames, transform from registration.json); composite(character frames, cast frames, sockets, out/composite_cast_S, 20) → per-frame composites + composite.mp4 + sockets.json; attachment.evaluate(cast frames placed at the sockets as the function expects, sockets) and pse on the composite frames → append to checks.json under composite. Also out/vfx_sheet_review.png: the three modules' frames in rows on #3a3f4a, numbered; and encode travel as a 12 fps loop and impact as a 20 fps play-once with review/encode.py into out/vfx/travel_12fps.mp4 and out/vfx/impact_20fps.mp4 (2× Lanczos).
No image_gen. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used 0. Deliver within 13 minutes.
RETURN: receipt task_id "K4v-chk-01"; images []; files: every out/ file with sha256; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns naming anything not computed. Never PASS/FAIL.
